headline: Traders Seek Long-Term Crude Supply Deals with Qatar for 2027
summary: International oil trading houses are in talks with state-owned QatarEnergy to secure Qatari crude oil supplies for 2027, focusing on Qatar Marine and Land grades amid recovering Strait of Hormuz flows.
why: QatarEnergy is a major state-owned petroleum producer in the Middle East, and long-term supply deals influence global crude availability and trade flows for physical oil markets.

impacts.name: QatarEnergy
impacts.why: Traders are in talks with QatarEnergy to receive supplies of crude oil.
